niche_preference_profile: Prefers calm, polished interfaces that feel organized, complete, and easy to scan. They consistently like clear modular grouping, stronger hierarchy, visible task-relevant content and actions, restrained clutter, and supportive conversational tone. They often favor soft rounded cards, integrated search/section treatments, and interfaces that feel composed rather than noisy or mechanically instructional.

criteria.description: Content is separated into distinct cards or sections with strong grouping, rather than merged into one long panel or fragmented inconsistently.
Layouts feel quiet and focused, with fewer competing controls, decorative elements, banners, arrows, dots, or extra chrome.
Information is easy to scan through bold titles, clear section labels, cleaner text grouping, and a top-down reading flow.
Screens look fully populated and intentionally finished, with visible items/options instead of sparse, empty, or unfinished states.
Copy and visual tone feel reassuring, conversational, friendly, and composed rather than urgent, harsh, procedural, or corporate.
Elements have generous spacing and calmer vertical rhythm instead of tight stacking or crowded composition.
Uses rounded, refined, contemporary cards and surfaces that feel polished and cohesive rather than rigid, clunky, or uneven.
Task-relevant controls are explicit and prominent, with clear CTAs and item-level actions that make management feel actionable.
Interfaces include human or personalized cues such as avatars, names, or expressive icon chips instead of generic placeholder treatment.
